icons.name: Hidden-v1
icons.prompt: Create one polished Unity poker game UI icon, centered and square. Match the supplied reference's deep emerald enamel, warm brushed champagne-gold metal relief, top-left soft light, restrained highlights. Bold shapes readable at 64 pixels. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks or checkerboard. True transparent alpha outside the complete silhouette. Use the reference circular badge rim exactly. Central emblem: one large elegant gold question mark, representing a mysterious hidden achievement. An exception to the no-text constraint is this single question-mark symbol. 5 percent transparent outer margin, full circle uncut.

backgroundRepair.prompt: BACKGROUND EXTRACTION ONLY. Preserve the entire circular gold-and-emerald badge, exact emblem, colors, geometry and light. Remove ALL the grey-white checkerboard outside the outer circular rim and replace it with REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA pixels. This input checkerboard is unwanted baked background, NOT a texture to retain. Export true RGBA PNG with fully transparent exterior and smoothly antialiased rim. Do not redraw or alter the badge. No flat-colored backdrop, no visible checkerboard.

icons.validation: Visually inspected; RGBA PNG and transparent exterior corner verified.
